![What is Minimum Viable (Data) Product? | by Dat Tran | idealo ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-343045924c71:4)
A Minimum Viable Product (MVP) is `the most basic version of a new product that contains just enough core features to be usable by early customers and test business ideas with little effort`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_viable_product)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/minimum-viable-product)

### Purpose and Benefits

- **Learn fast:** You see if people want your idea before spending a lot of time and money.
- **Save money:** You avoid building features that nobody wants or needs.
- **Reduce risk:** You test market demand in the real world with real users.
- **Get feedback:** Early users tell you what works and what needs to change.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/minimum-viable-product)[[2]](https://businesstech.bus.umich.edu/blog/why-minimum-viable-products-are-the-real-mvp/)[[3]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-minimum-viable-product)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=feok5MjGGEE)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_viable_product)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGymH7b2kFE&t=31)[[7]](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/career-development/minimum-viable-product)

### How to Build an MVP

- **Find the problem:** Learn what your target users struggle with.
- **Pick core features:** Choose only the "must-have" features that solve the main problem.
- **Build a simple version:** Create a basic product, landing page, or prototype quickly.
- **Test and listen:** Launch to early users and watch how they use it.
- **Improve:** Update your product based on what you learn.[[1]](https://businesstech.bus.umich.edu/blog/why-minimum-viable-products-are-the-real-mvp/)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/minimum-viable-product)[[3]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-minimum-viable-product)[[4]](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/career-development/minimum-viable-product)[[5]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/mvp-definition/)

If you are planning to build one, tell me:

- What is your **product idea**?
- Who is your **target audience**?

I can help you define the **core features** for your MVP.
